question: Seven boxes I, J, K, L, M, N and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only L is kept above M. Only P is kept between M and J. Only N is kept below K. How many boxes are kept between I and N?
solution:
Seven boxes I, J, K, L, M, N and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only L is kept above M.
 
• Only P is kept between M and J.
 
• Only N is kept below K.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
L
